criteria.billing: Funds already collected from, or due to, the customer
criteria.technical: Something in the software is broken or misbehaving
criteria.shipping: Physical parcels that have not yet reached the customer
criteria.returns: Goods the customer already holds and wants to hand over or swap
criteria.account: Access to, or identity details of, the customer's own sign-in
criteria.sales: Questions about purchasing, tiers or what things are priced at
criteria.legal: Contracts, compliance, regulation or formal requests
criteria.feedback: Opinions about the experience, with no defect to fix and no purchase to make
